Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: audit logs + BYOK + SSO details for procurement

Marissa —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Our procurement team needs a short evidence package to move the pilot contract forward. Can you confirm the following at a high level and share any existing artifacts: 

- What audit events are captured (auth, token issuance, model inference, admin actions)?
- Retention windows available for audit logs and whether we can carve out a shorter/longer retention for a POC.
- BYOK/KMS options: supported HSMs, key rotation cadence, and whether CMK import is supported.
- SSO: SCIM provisioning and SAML IdP metadata; any known gaps for our Okta setup.

We can accept redacted examples if that helps. Procurement would like this by EOD next Tue 6/6 (we're on an internal calendar) — ideally sooner.

Attaching their blank evidence template.

Regards,
Anika

ClearHealth

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Evidence request: audit logs + BYOK + SSO details for procurement

Marissa / Anika —

Short answers up-front while we pull artifacts: 
- Audit events: we capture auth successes/failures, token issuance/refresh, model invocation start/stop (per-request id), admin API calls (user/role changes), and console login attempts. We do not currently record raw prompt payloads in logs by default; only metadata (request id, model, user id).
- Retention: hosted customers get configurable retention between 30d and 2y out of the box; Dedicated/Private can request custom retention via SLA. For POC carveouts, we can propose a 90d interim window but need an ops exception for anything shorter than 30d.
- BYOK/KMS: We support AES-GCM CMK via AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in GCP KMS; HSM-backed Cloud KMS is supported. We do not yet support direct CMK import into our managed cluster HSMs (planned Q3 roadmap). Rotation: recommend 90d/180d depending on account policy; we can document rotation steps.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM supported. For Okta specifically: automated SCIM provisioning is functional, SAML metadata exchange is straightforward; edge case: Just-in-time group sync for nested groups requires a small mapping script on your side.

I’ll attach a redacted 7-day audit excerpt and a short summary doc within the hour. If ClearHealth needs evidence signed by our compliance team, loop Laura in (I’ve cc’d her on next steps).

— Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_audit_excerpt.txt (TXT)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: audit logs + BYOK + SSO details for procurement

Thanks — some product clarifications and one roadmap note: 

- BYOK import: as Neha said, importing a raw CMK into our managed HSMs is not supported today. For POCs we can either use your cloud KMS (recommended) or run a Private deployment that supports key import (requires infra lead time).
- Audit schema: we maintain a stable event schema v1.3 — I’ll attach the schema doc. We can also provide a sample mapping to your SIEM (CEF/JSON) as an export.
- Retention exception: Product is comfortable with a 90d POC window, but any shorter retention (e.g., 7-14d) would require a formal operational exception since our automated tiering expects >=30d buckets. That exception needs Ops approval (cc Marcus).

ETA: I can post the schema + mapping by 3pm PT. For the BYOK import ask, recommend we propose two options to ClearHealth: (1) use their own cloud KMS keys (fast), (2) Private deployment with key import (timeline 6-8 wks).

— Karthik
Director, Product — Infra & Platform, Redwood Inference

All —

I reviewed the ask. Operational notes and next steps: 

- I’ve prepared a redacted 7-day audit extract (attached) showing auth + admin events with request ids; no prompt text included. This is safe to share.
- For retention: we can approve a 90d POC retention without leadership sign-off. Anything <30d will require a documented Ops exception and will need scheduling with infra (might delay timeline by 2–3 weeks).
- BYOK: for a hosted pilot, we recommend customer-managed cloud KMS (AWS/GCP). Private deployment with imported keys is possible — however procurement must sign the Private deployment order and allow our infra window.
- SSO: our SCIM implementation will work with Okta; we can provide a test tenant for validation.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marissa: send ClearHealth the one-page cover note + the redacted extract and product schema (I attached the archive link).
2) Anika: confirm if they want the hosted-with-customer-KMS path (fast) or pursue Private deploy + key import (longer).
3) Laura: if procurement wants a signed compliance statement, Laura can draft a short attestation.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call with ClearHealth tomorrow morning if needed.

— Marcus
Head of Site Reliability, Redwood Inference
